title: Hand-Pressed Vinyl & Quartet Merch — Kansas City Jazz
announcement: Welcome to Crossroads Music Shop. I'm Jessica Webb, tenor and alto saxophonist and bandleader of The Jessica Webb Quartet. Every record here is hand-numbered and the merch is the same gear we wear on the bandstand. Proceeds help keep Crossroads Conservatory running. Ships from Kansas City.

policy_welcome: Welcome to Crossroads Music Shop — vinyl, CDs, and merch from a working Kansas City jazz quartet.
policy_payment: I accept all major credit cards, debit cards, Etsy gift cards, and PayPal through Etsy checkout.
policy_shipping: All items ship via USPS from Kansas City MO 64111. Orders typically ship within 3-5 business days. Expedited shipping available at checkout.
policy_refunds: Returns accepted within 14 days of delivery for unused items in original condition. Please message me first to arrange a return. Signed and personalized orders are final sale.
